description: This file defines the Zend_XmlRpc_Client class, which implements an XML-RPC client for communicating with remote XML-RPC servers. It manages request/response handling, HTTP communication, and method invocation.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Client
classes.description: Implements an XML-RPC client for remote procedure calls, managing request/response, HTTP communication, and method proxies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the XML-RPC client with server URL and optional HTTP client.

methods.name: setHttpClient
methods.description: Sets the HTTP client used for requests.

methods.name: setIntrospector
methods.description: Sets the object used for remote server introspection.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Returns the last XML-RPC request made.

methods.name: getLastResponse
methods.description: Returns the last XML-RPC response received.

methods.name: getProxy
methods.description: Returns a proxy object for a specific namespace for easier method calls.

methods.name: setSkipSystemLookup
methods.description: Sets whether to skip system method signature lookup.

methods.name: skipSystemLookup
methods.description: Checks if system method signature lookup is skipped.

methods.name: doRequest
methods.description: Performs the XML-RPC request and loads the response.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Calls a remote method with parameters, handling request creation, execution, and response/error processing.

methods.name: _createRequest
methods.description: Creates a new XML-RPC request object for a method call.
